meta.title: Gold Timeframe Table — Enhanced
meta.version: 1.0 - Enemy spell tracker (EXP/JG/MID/GOLD/ROAM) + battle spells CD
meta.based_on: Same timeframe structure as Roam guide (0:00-18:00, 11 steps) + online verification for Season 42 Patch 2.2.23 live 11 Nov 2026. Patch 2.2.23 supersedes 2.2.16a: Popol and Kupa revamp, Gloo/Masha/Atlas nerfed, Xavier/Lunox/Freya/Aldous/Kaja/Melissa buffed, Sprint 100s->75s, Chastise Pauldron weaker, Antique Cuirass stronger, Concussive Blast 50% less damage to minions.
meta.how_to_use: Each role has steps aligned to real objective spawns. Use startSeconds/endSeconds for your in-game timer UI. Check checklist for what to do, decision for fight vs run, dont for most common throw. In solo queue, prioritize checklist over forcing a fight.

turtle.reward: Gold + large EXP for team. Last-hit: instant heal + self-repairing shield + adaptive damage.
turtle.note: First Turtle always spawns next to EXP lane. Season 42 Healing Turtle: killing it summons a Turtle that pushes strongest lane + heals instead of shield.

lord.first_spawn_rule: Exactly 120s after last Turtle slain. Example: Turtle slain 7:45 -> Lord 9:45. If Turtle not slain by 8:00 and no damage for 5s, Lord replaces Turtle after 5s, delayed up to 9:00.
lord.reward: Lord pushes weakest lane, buffs waves, charges turret for 30% Max HP True damage (8-18min).
lord.note: Lord is NOT fixed at 8:00 if you tap slain. Widget counts 2 min after last Turtle if you tap.

lithowanderer.note: River crab. Small team reward + short river benefit.

global_rules: Never start Lord with enemy jungler + Retribution alive nearby.
Trade your life only for objective or carry's life.
After won fight, convert to tower/objective immediately.
If you lose lanes, give up Turtle and take opposite side.

compact_mode.goal: Widget must stay 2 rows tall in landscape. Collapsed shows callout only. Expanded shows full description, checklist, vision, decision, dont.
compact_mode.heroes_note: Heroes are pre-game only. Hide heroes in live view, show only when timer is 0 and expanded.
compact_mode.width_rule: Portrait 98% width, landscape 62% width so it does not cover the fight.

meta.beginner_friendly: Merged objective + description into one instruction per step. Tuned for Grandmaster to Epic.
meta.adaptive_height: Collapsed has no maxLines limit, height wraps to fit full description. No truncation.
sources: timesaver.gg Best Jungle / EXP Lane heroes Season 42 Patch 2.2.23
mlbbhub / mlbb.io ranked trackers via timesaver.gg summaries
mlbbdex Weekly Meta Report 19 Nov 2026 Patch 2.2.23

gold_mechanics.gold_bonus: Gold lane gives extra gold per minion + siege minion bonus. Patch 2.2.23 raised Gold Lane siege minion extra gold 40% -> 60%. Do not miss siege minion.
gold_mechanics.last_hit: Last-hit every minion. Missing cannon is biggest loss.
gold_mechanics.freeze_vs_push: Freeze near tower by last-hitting only if pressured - forces enemy to overextend for gank.
gold_mechanics.gank_timing: Enemy jungler finishes first clear around 1:15-1:30. Do not push with no vision then.
gold_mechanics.rotate_rule: Farm first, fight later. First 5 min: clear every wave, leave lane only for first Turtle (if wave cleared + winnable) or turret under threat. After 2 core items (around 7-10 min), join Turtle/Lord/mid fights from behind frontline.
gold_mechanics.golden_turret: Patch 2.2.23: Golden Turret base HP 1000 -> 2000, team gold from outer/inner turret 100/140 -> 90/120.
gold_mechanics.positioning: Gold laner is main late damage. Stay behind frontline, save Flicker. One death late can end game.
gold_mechanics.solo_queue_note: Solo queue: Obsidia / Bruno / Hanabi are top Gold, but Obsidia is heavily banned. Have low-ban backup (Karrie / Claude / Melissa).

gold_types_verified.note: Gold archetypes use verified Specialty tags + Gold lane filter Nov 2026 Patch 2.2.23.

mapping.early_fighter: Early Fighter - Win lane early, snowball.

hero_pool_rule.rule: Marksman / Fighter only AND in current Gold heroes list (Lane contains Gold, Nov 2026, Patch 2.2.23).
